svg.aria-label: Docker Compose: Run docker compose build && docker compose up -d. Then open http://localhost:8080 (http://localhost:8080). No Docker: Use any static server on the repo root, for example python3 -m http.server 8080. The page fetches /data/articles.json by absolute path. Never from disk: Do not open index.html from disk (file://). Browsers block ES modules and fetch() there
